tasks.title: P1: Test harness for API and frontend utilities
tasks.description: Add Vitest (frontend) and an API test setup for server/index.js so later fixes are test-driven.
tasks.details: Server is a single ~890-line server/index.js. Export the Express app without calling listen() when imported (check whether server is ESM or CJS first), point the data directory at a temp folder via env var for tests, add a test script to server/package.json (supertest or node:test). Add Vitest to the root package.json with one smoke test of csv-utils. Do not change app behaviour in this task.
tasks.testStrategy: 'npm test' at root and in server/ run and pass at least one smoke test each

tasks.title: P1: CI on main and pull requests
tasks.description: Run typecheck, build and tests on every PR and push to main (today CI only runs on the redesign branch).
tasks.details: Existing workflow: .github/workflows/rf-preview-e2e.yml (branch-limited). Add a new workflow rather than editing it. Node 20. Steps: npm ci, tsc --noEmit, vite build, root tests, server tests.
tasks.testStrategy: Open a PR with a deliberately failing test and see the check fail; revert and see it pass

tasks.title: P1: Enforce admin role on user routes server-side
tasks.description: Today any logged-in user can create, promote or delete users, including the admin. Enforce roles in the API.
tasks.details: server/index.js: authenticateToken only at GET/POST /api/users, PUT/DELETE /api/users/:id (~lines 112, 217, 271, 304). Add requireAdmin middleware. Rules: only admin lists/creates/updates/deletes users; a user may read and change only their own password; nobody can change their own role; the last admin cannot be deleted or demoted. Take the role from the verified token, never from the request body.
tasks.testStrategy: API tests: operator token gets 403 on create/promote/delete user and on self-promotion; admin succeeds; deleting the last admin is refused

tasks.title: P1: Replace public init-admin with one-time setup
tasks.description: POST /api/users/init-admin is unauthenticated and creates admin/admin123 when the user list is empty.
tasks.details: server/index.js ~line 324. Remove the route. First admin is created by a one-time script (server/reset-admin.js exists; review it) or env vars ADMIN_USERNAME/ADMIN_PASSWORD read once at startup only when no users exist, with no default password. Update docs/README for the new first-run step. Check the frontend does not call init-admin.
tasks.testStrategy: API test: route returns 404; with an empty user list, no account exists until the setup script/env is used; no 'admin123' string remains in the repo (grep)

tasks.title: P1: Require JWT_SECRET at startup
tasks.description: The server falls back to a public default secret, which allows forged admin tokens.
tasks.details: server/index.js line 17. Exit with a clear error if JWT_SECRET is missing or shorter than 32 chars. Update .env.example and the Docker/compose docs. DEPLOY RISK: the API will refuse to start on the VPS if JWT_SECRET is not set there. Ask the owner to confirm (open question in PRD) before this reaches production, and note that changing the secret logs everyone out.
tasks.testStrategy: Starting the server without JWT_SECRET exits non-zero with a message; with a valid secret the existing API tests pass

tasks.title: P1: Login rate limit, password rules, CORS allow-list
tasks.description: Audit: 51 bad logins in a row all just 401; passwords need only 3 characters; CORS is open.
tasks.details: server/index.js: cors() at line 26, login route ~line 199. Add express-rate-limit on /api/login (and user creation), minimum password length 10 on create/change, CORS restricted to an origin list from env (default same-origin).
tasks.testStrategy: API tests: the Nth bad login returns 429; a short password is rejected; request from a non-listed Origin gets no CORS header

tasks.details: server/index.js validKeys is duplicated at ~lines 361 and 383. Move to one shared constant and add the four keys. Check export-page.tsx and settings-page.tsx:187 for the keys they use.
tasks.testStrategy: API tests: GET and POST of each of the four keys succeeds for an authenticated user and still returns 400 for an unknown key
